title: Filtering the categories table by text · part 2

steps.title: Keep rows where description is Moroccan spices, teas and herbs
steps.prompt:
WHERE is a sieve: only rows that pass the test stay.
Text values wear quotes, like 'Moroccan spices, teas and herbs'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM categories WHERE description = 'Moroccan spices, teas and herbs';
hints: Wrap the text value in single quotes.
Write: SELECT * FROM categories WHERE description = 'Moroccan spices, teas and herbs';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM categories WHERE description = 'Moroccan spices, teas and herbs';

steps.title: Search with LIKE for names starting 'Mor'
steps.prompt:
LIKE searches by pattern using the % wildcard.
Mor% means 'starts with'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM categories WHERE description LIKE 'Mor%';
hints: Write: SELECT * FROM categories WHERE description LIKE 'Mor%';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM categories WHERE description LIKE 'Mor%';

steps.title: Search with LIKE for 'oro' anywhere
steps.prompt:
Putting % on BOTH sides matches the text anywhere.
This %oro% means 'contains'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM categories WHERE description LIKE '%oro%';
hints: Wrap the text in %% on both sides.
Write: SELECT * FROM categories WHERE description LIKE '%oro%';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM categories WHERE description LIKE '%oro%';
